pages.title: Finding Oureclase
pages.text: Default deposits: Overworld, Y 0 to 96. Veins target up to 6 blocks, with 7 placement attempts per chunk. Mining requirement: level 3.

pages.title: Working Oureclase
pages.text: Smelt Oureclase Ore or Oureclase Dust into ingots. Crushing the ore first normally yields two dusts. Ingots can be stored as metal blocks or converted into the material's other crafting forms.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 198 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 3.$(br)Mining efficiency: 8.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 4.1.$(br)Enchantability: 26.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 5, leggings 6, boots 4.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 2.5.$(br)Enchantability: 26.

pages.title: Pickaxe: Crushing
pages.text: Mining ores drops 1 dust of that metal instead of the ore.

pages.title: Weapon: Pulverize
pages.text: Deals 2x the original damage to enemies with full health.

pages.title: Armor: Stampede
pages.text: Sprinting slightly damages and knocks back nearby entities.
